purpose: Amendment to the frozen T9d FP32/MPS protocol v2: retry domain-adaptation training on engineering-judgment corpus v3 (1080/324/216/324) with two arms that isolate the two competing explanations of the W42 failure — backbone damage under full fine-tuning (Arm A controls for it) versus insufficient data scale (Arm B controls for it).

bound_protocol.relationship: amendment: inherits the frozen recipe (objective, loss, steps, eval cadence, batching, budgets, runtime, selection and reporting rules) verbatim; changes only (a) the training corpus version and (b) the per-arm backbone update rule. Every other parameter is identical across arms and identical to protocol v2.

w42_full_backbone_v2_corpus.finding: Full-backbone FP32 training on corpus v2 (102 train questions) overfit instantly: train loss collapsed to ~1e-4 while dev CE rose from ~1.15-1.21 to 2.7-3.1; dev selection picked step 0 for 2 of 3 seeds; the only non-zero selection (seed17) regressed the independent heldout to 0.362 vs the 0.464 atomic baseline; coverage@0.9 remained 0/69.

jd5_backbone_attribution.finding: Head/training is the gap, not backbone capacity: full fine-tuning damaged the backbone's native readout. Motivates a frozen-backbone arm.

w43c_corpus_v3.finding: Corpus v3 built: 1944 items / 324 components / 18 families, isolation audit green (zero overlap with heldout_v1 and corpus v2), preflight status passed_not_training_authorized.

arm_A_head_only.hypothesis: If head/training is the gap (J-D5) and the backbone already encodes usable features, training only the decision head should improve dev CE and heldout without damaging the backbone's native readout. A negative result here means the head alone cannot close the gap at this head capacity or that the backbone features are not linearly/head-separable for engineering judgment.
arm_A_head_only.script_delta_vs_frozen_trainer: train_pipeline_decisions_v3.py is a byte-copy of the frozen trainer plus exactly one feature: --freeze-backbone keeps backbone parameters out of the gradient graph (requires_grad False for the entire run) and accepts --backbone-lr 0; the phase label records 'head_frozen_backbone'. Optimizer param groups, loss, batching, evaluation and selection code paths are untouched. Frozen trainer hash d1942528…dd0a is not modified.

arm_B_full_backbone_v3_scale.hypothesis: W42 failed at 102 train questions; corpus v3 provides 1080 (10.6x) with 324 dev / 216 calibration / 324 test. If the W42 failure was primarily a data-scale artifact, the identical full-backbone recipe on v3 should dev-select a non-zero step and improve heldout; if it still overfits instantly and selects step 0, the failure is attributable to the update rule itself, not scale.

data_contract.validated_by: train_pipeline_decisions_v3.py --validate-only: 1944 records, all questions eligible for gold_distribution

heldout.role: independent heldout; evaluation only, never trained on

selection_and_reporting.selection_metric: target cross-entropy (inherited from protocol v2, unchanged)
selection_and_reporting.last_point_rule: If the minimum is the final registered evaluation point, report budget exhaustion and lack of convergence; do not add steps after observing results.
post_run_evaluation: heldout_v1 predict per seed via scripts/predict_toy_decisions.py (fp32/mps, batch-questions 8, max-length 2048) -> results/heldout_v1_post_v3_{arm}_seed{N}.json; accuracy, coverage@0.9, mean confidence vs the 0.464 G4 heldout baseline (results/heldout_v1_g4_baseline.json)
corpus v3 test accuracy per question type from predictions_test.jsonl in each run dir vs the 0.44 atomic eng-test reference
selection_and_reporting.mps_contention_rule: No predict or lifecycle calls while a training run occupies MPS; evaluations run strictly after each arm completes.

honest_prior.statement: W42 is a documented negative result for this recipe at 102-question scale, and W43-B falsified grouped calibration at current scale. Prior belief: Arm B is more likely than not to overfit again (full backbone + 300 steps is a large update budget even at 1080 questions); Arm A is the more plausible arm but may still fail if the gap is not head-separable. This run is a diagnostic, not an expected promotion.

preregistered_interpretation.A_wins_B_fails: supports J-D5 (update rule damaged the backbone); next lever is head-only or adapter training
preregistered_interpretation.B_wins: W42 was a data-scale artifact; full-backbone at v3 scale is viable
preregistered_interpretation.both_fail: neither scale nor freezing suffices; next levers are LoRA/adapter, curriculum, or representation-level approaches
preregistered_interpretation.both_pass: report per-seed minima; promotion still requires the protocol v2 paired gates, which this amendment does not run

authorization.scope: research training run of exactly the two arms and three seeds declared above, plus the listed post-run measurements

nanojev_lifecycle_receipt.outcome: abstained (confidence 0.402 < 0.9 gate); proceeded deterministically per AGENTS.md; advisory only, no authorization taken from the local model
